# Screenmac

> Screenmac is a free, native macOS app for screenshots and screen recordings: capture an area, a window or a whole display, annotate it, redact what's private, and copy, save or share it. No account, nothing uploaded.

Key facts:
- Platform: macOS 14 Sonoma or later; one universal build for Apple silicon and Intel.
- Price: free during the beta. A paid Pro tier is planned but not built and not for sale.
- Current version: 0.3.0 (beta). Builds are ad-hoc signed and not yet notarized by Apple.
- Built with SwiftUI, AppKit and Apple's ScreenCaptureKit. Not Electron.
- Privacy: captures and history stay in a folder on the Mac. There is no upload feature. Redact, blur and pixelate are flattened into the exported pixels.
- Default shortcuts: Option-Shift-Command-4 area, Option-Shift-Command-2 window, Option-Shift-Command-3 full screen, Option-Shift-Command-5 record.
- Install: `curl -fsSL https://www.screenmac.app/install.sh | bash`, or download Screenmac.zip from GitHub Releases.
- Source: https://github.com/iam8uman/screenmac (by Suman Sharma).

## Product

- [Home](https://www.screenmac.app/): What Screenmac does, a live in-browser annotation editor, install instructions and FAQ.
- [Download and install](https://www.screenmac.app/download): The one-line installer, the zip download, first-launch steps and building from source.
- [Features](https://www.screenmac.app/features): Every capability with its status: in the Mac beta, in the browser editor, or planned.
- [Browser editor](https://www.screenmac.app/editor): The annotation editor running in the browser; open your own screenshot, mark it up and export a PNG.
- [Pricing](https://www.screenmac.app/pricing): Free beta; Pro is listed as not available.
- [Guides](https://www.screenmac.app/blog): All screenshot and screen recording guides by topic.
- [Free tools](https://www.screenmac.app/tools): Browser tools and quizzes.

## Releases

- [Latest release](https://github.com/iam8uman/screenmac/releases/latest): Screenmac.zip and its SHA-256 checksum, built by GitHub Actions.
- [Changelog](https://www.screenmac.app/changelog): What changed in each version.

## Optional

- [Support](https://www.screenmac.app/support): Help with permissions and common problems.

## Free tools

- [Screenshot Editor](https://www.screenmac.app/editor): Annotate, blur, pixelate and crop a screenshot in your browser, then export a PNG. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Mac Screenshot Shortcuts Finder](https://www.screenmac.app/tools/mac-screenshot-shortcuts): Pick what you want to capture and where it should go; get the exact macOS shortcut.
- [Which Mac Screenshot Tool Do You Need?](https://www.screenmac.app/quiz/which-mac-screenshot-tool): Six questions to find out whether the built-in tools are enough or which kind of app fits.

## Screenshots

- [How to Screenshot on a Mac: Every Shortcut and Option](https://www.screenmac.app/blog/how-to-screenshot-on-mac): Every way to take a screenshot on a Mac: full screen, an area, a window without its shadow, to the clipboard, with a timer, and how to change where screenshots are saved.

## Related apps by the same developer

- [Windowmac](https://www.windowmac.app/): Free, open-source window manager for macOS. Hold Option and flick a window into place.
- [Slidemac](https://www.slidemac.app/): Turns the edges of a Mac trackpad into sliders for volume, brightness, app switching and keyboard light.
